parsed.summary: The change sets a default Referrer-Policy of 'same-origin' for security improvements. Documentation is updated accordingly.

issues.description: This change introduces a behavioral regression risk for websites that rely on the Referer header for verification. While this is a fragile technique, it could break existing functionality.
